info.title: suno-api
info.description: Use API to call the music generation service of Suno.ai and easily integrate it into agents like GPTs.

post.description:
It will automatically fill in the lyrics.

2 audio files will be generated for each request, consuming a total of 10 credits.

`wait_audio` can be set to API mode:

• By default, it is set to `false`, which indicates the background mode. It will only return audio task information, and you will need to call the get API to retrieve detailed audio information.

• If set to `true`, it simulates synchronous mode. The API will wait for a maximum of 100s until the audio is generated, and will directly return the audio link and other information. Recommend using in GPTs and other agents.

get.description: Newest-first event log that backs the /status page. `inFlight` counts events still pending.
Suno's verification token (`browser-token` header), sent from the user's own browser by `scripts/capture-browser-token.js`. The token is never returned.

post.description: Token must be at least 40 characters. The response gives only its length.

post.summary: Open a browser and wait for a verification token.
post.description: Opens a browser and waits for you to make a generation by hand. It can wait up to an hour. Returns at once if a token is already held. The token stays on the server.

get.summary: Expiry date of the Suno session cookie.
get.description: Returns the date only. The cookie is never returned.

get.summary: Authenticated GET to any Suno API path.
get.description: Reaches Suno endpoints that have no typed route. Path must begin with `/api/`. Suno's own status is in `suno_status`, so a 404 is a usable probe result.

post.description: Non-GET methods must be named here, so a stray GET never changes anything.

post.summary: Replace a time window inside a song (infill).
post.description: Regenerates one window and keeps the rest. Costs about 4 credits. It returns only the window plus the lead-in and lead-out, not the finished song. Join it with `scripts/splice-infill.mjs`.

get.summary: Read a Suno Studio project (read only).
get.description: Studio times are in beats: seconds = beats / bps. Find a project id in `metadata.studio_project_id` of a clip of type `studio_export` or `edit_v3_export`.
